investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ardmark Education (online learning); Platform: Microsoft Azure northeurope (zones northeurope-1/northeurope-2/northeurope-3); network range 10.71.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ardmar-prod-northe (AKS); Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-03, maxmemory 4gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the certificate-svc PostgreSQL database certificate-db-01; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
